subject: Strange issue, occasionally cannot click on anything

messages.author: 8c80d5cd7a4e6600
messages.subject: Strange issue, occasionally cannot click on anything
parts:
I have a rather strange issue that I cant really figure out how/when it happens so I cant reliably reproduce it. I wanted to see if anyone else has encountered something like this.
Once and a while while using shiny with shinydashboard the entire screen becomes unclickable (however not greyed out) and everytime I click it just selects the entire screen.
In chrome if I click Inspect then go back to the main screen it returns to normal. I apologize for how vague this sounds but I really dont know ever where to begin with this bug.

messages.author: 4317e7b9c140bf2d
messages.subject: Re: Strange issue, occasionally cannot click on anything
parts: Trevor - Having shiny-relevant variables (i.e, inputs, outputs, etc.) with duplicate names causes something like this, although I've never had it return to normal. This typically happens to me when I copy/paste some working code then forget to update the variable names. - Tom
